name.description: The name of the feature state. Not needed with --root.
name.x-prompt: What should be the name of the state?

path.description: The path to create the state folder in.

flat.description: Has no effect: the state file is always created in the statePath folder.

skipTests.description: Has no effect: this schematic creates no spec file.

module.description: The NgModule (path) to register the state in. Without it, the nearest NgModule is used, if the app has one.
module.x-prompt: To which module (path) should the state be registered in?

statePath.description: The folder, relative to the path, to create the state file (index.ts) in.

root.description: Flag to setup the root state or feature state.

stateInterface.description: Specifies the interface for the state.

minimal.description: With --root, registers StoreModule.forRoot({}) without creating the state file.
